features: 40 causal context features + 6 candidate parameters + each v29 seed expected-net and fill outputs; raw forecasts are available only for earlier completed folds
selection: One fixed shared HGB net/fill meta-ranker per chronological fold; no winner fold, seed, threshold, or portfolio tuning.
target: Calendar-geometric net >=5% monthly and global drawdown <=20% after normal fee, fee-stress and execution-stress scenarios; at least30 fills in each scenario.
compute: Local CPU inference/meta-fit/replay only; no cloud upload; research-only and no live approval.
